name: TANFAC Industries Ltd
title: TANFAC Industries Ltd-$ - 506854 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR711 crores (+27%) but EBITDA margin fell to 16% from 23%; INR495 crores capex for 20,000 t HFC-32 depends on a quota still undecided by government, with 65% of capacity pre-booked.

utilisation.quote: the hydrofluoric plant operated at around 95% utilization levels, reflecting strong demand and efficient operations.

capex.peers_comment: Management said the HFC quota will be decided by government; incumbents SRF, GFL, Navin were referenced by analyst, not by management.
capex.quote: we have already announced a capital expenditure plan of approximately INR495 crores.

triggers.label: HFC-32 quota undecided; capex INR405 crores
triggers.quote: the whole quota is arising out of an international agreement among various countries and this is the quota which will be decided at the national level

triggers.label: Sulphuric acid utilisation 101%
triggers.quote: The Sulphuric acid plant operated at 101% capacity utilization

triggers.label: Pass-through lag 30-40 days
triggers.quote: there is a lag of around 30 to 40 days. So that's only, we are running on that.

triggers.label: HFC-32 65% of capacity contracted
triggers.quote: Collectively, these contracts account for nearly 65% of the proposed capacity

guidance.quote: we expect operating EBITDA margins to remain range-bound around 15% to 18% from existing line of business.
remains on track for the commissioning by Q3 in the year FY27.
we expect it will be less than four years.
FY28 I think we should be close to around INR2,000 crores, INR1,600 to INR2,000 crores

red_flags.label: HFC-32 quota not allocated; no penalty if quota denied
red_flags.quote: So there is no penalty clause due to this or anything.

red_flags.label: Evasive on quota allocation
red_flags.quote: We would not like to comment any more on this.

red_flags.label: Margin decline; sulphur cost up
red_flags.quote: the prices of sulphur has increased in FY26, used to be around INR30 per kg in FY25, increased up to INR38 to INR40 per kg

evasions.quote: We would not like to comment any more on this.
Difficult to comment on this, confidential as of now, Siddharth.
